items.name: Haria Wise
items.detail: Harold Fannin Jr.'s sister Haria Wise died Oct. 23, 2023, at age 20, during his sophomore season at Bowling Green.

items.name: Ashley Griggs
items.detail: Carnell Tate's mother, Ashley Griggs, was killed in a drive-by shooting in Chicago's Garfield Park neighborhood early on July 16, 2023, before his freshman season at Ohio State.

items.name: Peggy Prescott
items.detail: Dak Prescott's mother, Peggy, died of colon cancer on Nov. 3, 2013, while he was at Mississippi State.

items.name: Jace Prescott
items.detail: Dak Prescott's older brother Jace died by suicide on April 23, 2020, at his home in Orange, Texas. Dak has since spoken often about mental health.

items.name: Luke Knox
items.detail: Dawson Knox's younger brother Luke, a 22-year-old FIU football player, was found dead on campus on the night of Aug. 17, 2022. Dawson has since worked on grief and suicide-prevention causes.

items.name: Manuel Wilson
items.detail: Emanuel Wilson's father, Manuel Wilson, died Aug. 11, 2009, in Roanoke, Va. Wilson has talked about playing with his father in mind.
Josh Allen's grandmother died the day before the Bills' Week 9 win over Seattle on Nov. 8, 2020, and he played the next day. Fans donated heavily to a children's hospital in her honor.

items.name: Robert Stevenson
items.detail: Rhamondre Stevenson's father, Robert, died suddenly in March 2025 at age 54. Stevenson missed spring workouts and has worn a game-day tribute to him.

items.name: Aron Diggs
items.detail: Stefon Diggs' father, Aron, died of congestive heart failure in January 2008, when Stefon was 14. He helped raise his younger brothers, including Trevon.

items.name: Orbin Love
items.detail: Jordan Love's father, Orbin, a police officer, died by suicide when Jordan was 14 (around 2012–13). Love wrote about it in The Players' Tribune in 2025.

items.name: Lamar Jackson Sr.
items.detail: Lamar Jackson's father died of a heart attack in 2005, the same day as Lamar's grandmother. Lamar was 8.

items.name: Mickey Evans
items.detail: Mike Evans' father, Mickey, was killed by a family member at their Galveston, Texas, home when Mike was 9 (around 2002–03). Evans has spoken about forgiving the killer.

items.name: Taylor Swift
items.detail: Travis Kelce married Taylor Swift on July 3, 2026, at Madison Square Garden in New York.

items.name: Mya Danielle
items.detail: DeVonta Smith married Mya Danielle on June 13, 2026, at the Four Seasons at Walt Disney World.

items.name: Katya Kuropas
items.detail: J.J. McCarthy married Katya Kuropas on April 11, 2026.

items.name: Haley Cavinder
items.detail: Jake Ferguson married former college basketball star Haley Cavinder on June 20, 2026.

items.name: Aliyah Hunter
items.detail: Jaylin Noel married Aliyah Hunter on March 26, 2026.

items.name: Kelsey Nicole Riley
items.detail: A.J. Brown married Kelsey Nicole Riley on May 16, 2026.

items.name: Katie Hoofnagle
items.detail: Sam Darnold married Katie Hoofnagle on April 3, 2026, at Rancho Valencia in California.

items.name: Olivia Carter
items.detail: Michael Penix Jr. married Olivia Carter on May 2, 2026, at Chateau Elan in Georgia.

items.name: Jillian Cataldo
items.detail: Pat Freiermuth married Jillian Cataldo on June 20, 2026.

items.name: Hailee Steinfeld
items.detail: Josh Allen married actress Hailee Steinfeld on May 31, 2025, in Santa Barbara County, California.

items.name: Ronika Stone
items.detail: Jordan Love married volleyball player Ronika Stone on June 29, 2025.

items.name: Ann Michael Hudson
items.detail: Drake Maye married his childhood sweetheart Ann Michael Hudson on June 21, 2025, in North Carolina.

items.name: Leanna Lenee
items.detail: Travis Hunter married Leanna Lenee on May 24, 2025, in Chattanooga, Tennessee, about a month after the draft.

items.name: Olivia Culpo
items.detail: Christian McCaffrey married Olivia Culpo on June 29, 2024, in Watch Hill, Rhode Island.

items.name: Jenna Brandt
items.detail: Brock Purdy married his college sweetheart Jenna Brandt in Des Moines, Iowa, on Saturday, March 9, 2024.

items.name: Christen Harper
items.detail: Jared Goff married model Christen Harper on June 22, 2024, in Ojai, California.

items.name: Brittany Matthews
items.detail: Patrick Mahomes married his high school sweetheart Brittany Matthews on March 12, 2022, in Hawaii.

items.name: Marissa Mowry
items.detail: Trevor Lawrence married Marissa Mowry on Saturday, April 10, 2021, weeks before he was drafted first overall.

items.name: Emily Wilkinson
items.detail: Baker Mayfield married Emily Wilkinson in Malibu on Saturday, July 6, 2019.

items.name: Kelly Hall
items.detail: Matthew Stafford married Kelly Hall in Atlanta on Saturday, April 4, 2015.

items.name: Julie Hampton
items.detail: Kirk Cousins married Julie Hampton on June 28, 2014, in Atlanta.

items.name: Izzy Smoke
items.detail: Bo Nix married Izzy Smoke, a former Auburn cheerleader, in July 2022.

items.name: James Cook
items.detail: James Cook's father, James Cook Sr. (also father of Dalvin Cook), died unexpectedly on Tuesday, Dec. 29, 2020, at 46, during James' final season at Georgia.

items.name: Gladys Henry
items.detail: Derrick Henry's grandmother Gladys, who helped raise him and inspired his faith, died Sept. 13, 2016, two days after his NFL debut.

items.name: Rondale Moore
items.detail: Kyle Pitts' close friend and former Falcons teammate Rondale Moore was found dead at his Indiana home on Feb. 21, 2026, at 25. Pitts later criticized players who skipped Moore's celebration of life.

items.name: Eric Higgins
items.detail: Tee Higgins' father, Eric, died in 2022. Higgins has called it one of the lowest points of his life and credits his mother, Lady Stewart, with carrying him through.

items.name: Don Richardson
items.detail: Deshaun Watson's father, Don Richardson, died in early September 2024; Watson announced it on Sept. 6, two days before the Browns' opener, and played that Sunday.

items.name: Lawrence Dobbins
items.detail: J.K. Dobbins' father, Lawrence, died of a stroke at 33 when J.K. was 15 (around 2014). Dobbins has said he plays to make him proud.

items.name: Doug Kraft
items.detail: Tucker Kraft's father, Doug, a former athlete, died in a plane accident in 2013 when Tucker was 12.

items.name: Lionel Nacua
items.detail: Puka Nacua's father, Lionel, died of complications from diabetes when Puka was 11 (around 2013). Nacua is often emotional before games and has honored him with custom cleats.

items.name: Alvin Jones Sr.
items.detail: Aaron Jones' father, Alvin Jones Sr., died suddenly at 57 on Tuesday, April 6, 2021. Jones later played with a necklace holding his father's ashes and scored 4 TDs on MNF that September.

items.name: Rod Godwin Sr.
items.detail: Chris Godwin's father, Rod Christopher Godwin Sr., died in January 2024. In 2025 Godwin added "Jr." to his name to honor him.

items.name: Betty Daniels
items.detail: Jayden Daniels' grandmother Betty died of COVID-19 on Feb. 5, 2021, her 77th birthday, less than a month after his grandfather William.

items.name: William Daniels
items.detail: Jayden Daniels' grandfather William, 78, was taken off life support after battling COVID-19 on Jan. 9, 2021, his and Betty's wedding anniversary.

items.name: Sally Otton
items.detail: Cade Otton's mother, Sally, died Sept. 20, 2022, in Tumwater, Washington, after years with Parkinson's disease, during his rookie season with the Bucs.

items.name: Randy Martin
items.detail: Patrick Mahomes' grandfather Randy Martin died in February 2025; his mother Randi announced it on Feb. 14, days after Super Bowl LIX.

items.name: Debbie Bates Martin
items.detail: Patrick Mahomes' grandmother Debbie Bates Martin died in early April 2023 after weeks of health problems.

items.name: Jean
items.detail: Kirk Cousins' grandmother Jean died suddenly in October 2017; he announced it on Oct. 22, the day before a Monday night game at Philadelphia.

items.name: Parker Schmidly
items.detail: Hunter Henry married Parker Schmidly, a labor and delivery nurse, on June 30, 2018, at The Grandeur House in Arkansas.

items.name: Emily
items.detail: Evan Engram married his wife Emily on April 12, 2024.

items.name: Baylee Jandahl
items.detail: Tucker Kraft married Baylee Jandahl in an outdoor ceremony in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, on May 18, 2024.

items.name: Ayanna Chapman
items.detail: Jonathan Taylor married his high school sweetheart Ayanna Chapman on March 15, 2023.

items.name: Lakyn Adkins
items.detail: Christian Watson married Lakyn Adkins, his girlfriend of seven years, on Friday, April 5, 2024, at Stone Mountain Estates in Malibu.

items.name: Mariah DelPercio
items.detail: Chris Godwin married Mariah DelPercio in 2021 after nine years together.

items.name: Callahan Dellinger
items.detail: Sam LaPorta married Callahan Dellinger in a Catholic ceremony on June 14, 2025; Pope Leo XIV blessed the couple 10 days later.
